newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia's envoy to France resigns.
newsitem.headline: Colombia's envoy to France resigns.

text.p: Colombia's envoy to France announced that he was stepping down on Wednesday and said he would stand as a candidate for mayor of Bogota this October.
"I hope to be back in Bogota within a maximum of two weeks," the outgoing ambassador, Nestor Humberto Martinez, said in an interview with local radio.
"I have decided to present my name as a candidate for mayor of Bogota," Martinez added in his remarks to the Radionet news programme.
Martinez, President Ernesto Samper's former justice minister, took up the prized Paris embassy post early last year.
Nationwide gubernatorial and mayoral elections are set to be held in October. They will be followed by congressional elections in March followed by presidential elections in May.
